sd4.text: Per organisation, per split: at most 8 pages in SET_P and at most 4 in SET_R. In addition, no organisation may contribute more than ORGANISATION_GATE_SHARE_CAP = 1/10 of ANY gate realised denominator. If the per-sample caps alone do not secure the 1/10 condition, that organisation contribution to the offending gate denominator is TRUNCATED by the same deterministic rank until the condition holds, and the truncation is recorded.

mathematicalRevalidation.method: analytic proof plus exhaustive/random integer brute force in a scratch script (not committed)
mathematicalRevalidation.notation: S(q) = sum_i min(c_i, q); f(q) = floor(S(q)/10); f is monotone non-decreasing in q and f(q) <= q0 for every q

proofs.nonIncreasing: q1 = f(q0) <= floor(sum c / 10) = q0; if q_(t+1) <= q_t then q_(t+2) = f(q_(t+1)) <= f(q_t) = q_(t+1) by monotonicity
proofs.terminates: a non-increasing sequence of non-negative integers stabilises in at most q0 + 1 steps
proofs.feasible: at the fixed point q* = floor(D*/10) with D* = S(q*); x_i <= q* gives 10*x_i <= 10*q* <= D*
proofs.greatest: for any feasible prefix vector y (y_i <= c_i, 10*y_i <= sum y) let m = max y_i; then m <= floor(sum y / 10) <= f(m) and m <= q0; induction gives m <= q_t for every t, so m <= q* and y_i <= min(c_i, m) <= x_i. Every fixed point in [0, q0] is <= q*, and none exists above q0.
proofs.uniqueGreatestVector: x dominates every feasible prefix vector componentwise and is itself feasible, so it is the unique greatest feasible retained vector
proofs.sequentialTailRemovalConverges: invariant y >= x: a current violator i has y_i > x_i (if y_i = x_i then 10*y_i <= sum x <= sum y); removing one tail item preserves y >= x; at the stop y is feasible so y <= x, hence y = x, for every choice sequence
proofs.simultaneousRemovalConverges: the same invariant holds when every current violator loses one tail item per round, and when every violator is set to floor(sum y / 10) (>= x_i because sum y >= sum x >= 10*x_i)
proofs.noOrderingParameter: follows from the two convergence results
